answer.short:
$X(-2,3)$

Double the centre coordinates, then subtract the coordinates of Y.
answer.worked:
The midpoint of the diameter is the centre.
$$\begin{align*}
\frac{x_X+4}{2}&=1\\
x_X+4&=2\\
x_X&=-2\\
\frac{y_X+(-1)}{2}&=1\\
y_X-1&=2\\
y_X&=3
\end{align*}$$
$X(-2,3)$.
